pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Starter Plan: €20 per month billed annually (€24 billed monthly) for 2,500 executions; Pro Plan: €50 per month billed annually (€60 billed monthly) for 10,000 executions… The Community Edition is free for self-hosted deployments with unlimited executions."

has_free_tier.note: Free self-hosted Community Edition; the cloud service is paid.

open_source.note: Source-available under a fair-code licence (not OSI open source). Editorial knowledge; pending verification.

plans.name: Community (self-hosted)
plans.quota: Unlimited executions on your own server

nl.tagline: Workflow-automatisering en AI-agents, zelf te hosten (Duitsland)
nl.description: n8n, uit Berlijn, is een automatiseringsplatform met een visuele editor, honderden integraties en sterke AI-agent-bouwstenen. Je kunt het gratis op je eigen server draaien, zodat data binnen je eigen omgeving blijft, of de betaalde cloudversie gebruiken.
bestFor: Zelf hosten met volledige controle over data
notFor: Wie geen technische kennis heeft of wil opdoen
limitations: Zelf hosten vraagt onderhoud; cloudprijzen zijn gebaseerd op executions

en.tagline: Workflow automation and AI agents you can self-host (Germany)
en.description: Berlin-based n8n is an automation platform with a visual editor, hundreds of integrations and strong AI-agent building blocks. You can run it free on your own server, keeping data in your own environment, or use the paid cloud version.
notFor: People without (or unwilling to gain) technical knowledge
limitations: Self-hosting requires maintenance; cloud pricing is execution-based
